If a planet is invaded by the {{Jet Brigade}} [[Jet Brigade]], Troopers will begin being replaced by their [[Jet Brigade Trooper|Jet Brigade variant]] on {{Difficulty|3}}.

If a planet is invaded by the {{Incineration Corps}} [[Incineration Corps]], Troopers will begin being replaced by their [[Pyro Trooper|Incineration Corps variant]] on {{Difficulty|4}}.

Starting on {{Difficulty|4}}, they can be found guarding [[Minor Places of Interest]].
Trooper.behavior:
Troopers and Raiders will fire their Fusion SMG in five-round bursts if a [[The Helldivers|Helldiver]] is in their line of sight. They take four seconds to cool their Fusion SMG before firing again, remaining stationary as they do. Troopers and Raiders will keep some distance from Helldivers, backing up if they approach, and punching them if they are too close. If a Helldiver is behind cover, Troopers and Raiders will toss a High Explosive Grenade. If it is [[Trooper#Gameplay|being suppressed]] by gunfire, it will erratically move its SMG, significantly reducing its accuracy.

When alerted to a Helldiver's presence, Troopers can fire a flare to call in a [[Dropship|Bot Drop]]. This behavior is shared by all Trooper-type Automatons, including [[Commissar]]s.

[[Cyborg Legion|Cyborg]] [[Agitator]]s can command squads of Troopers, making them move faster and group together. When under the orders of Agitators, their eyes glow bright orange.

Veracitor.title: Veracitor
Veracitor.spawning: Veracitors are part of the {{Appropriators}}[[Appropriators]] sub-faction of the Illuminate and can only spawn on worlds where the Appropriators are present. They begin spawning on {{Difficulty|4}} and onwards from [[Warp Ship]]s or patrols.
Veracitor.behavior:
Veracitors will pursue [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] by charging and approaching them with their leg-like appendages. Once close enough, they will swipe with their claws to deal damage. At range, they will cross their arms in order to protect the piloting [[Overseer]].
The pilot will also sometimes do a charge if far enough from the [[Helldiver|Helldivers]].

Voteless.title: Voteless
Voteless.spawning:
{{PAGENAME}} are the most prevalent Illuminate unit and are present in virtually every settlement, patrol, and enemy reinforcement. They additionally emerge frequently from [[Grounded Warp Ship]].

On planets where the {{Appropriators|text=Appropriators}} are exclusively active, the {{PAGENAME}} are completely absent. This absence is nullified by the addition of other subfactions which include the {{PAGENAME}}.
Voteless.behavior: {{PAGENAME}} attack by running towards Helldivers, attacking with a swipe of their claws when within melee range. Voteless are able to lunge a short distance towards targets that are slightly out of reach of their default attacking range.

Vox Engine.title: Vox Engine
Vox Engine.spawning:
Vox Engines are part of the Cyborg Legion sub-faction of the [[Automaton]]s and can only spawn on worlds where the Cyborgs are present. They begin spawning on {{Difficulty|7}} missions, either as part of a patrol, reinforcements, or in enemy-occupied locations.
The secondary objective [[Intercept Convoy]] on a cyborg-present planet will instead spawn five Vox Engines, patrolling from one end of the map to the other.
Vox Engine.behavior:
* Vox Engines replace [[Factory Strider]]s on {{Difficulty|7}} and above on planets where Cyborgs are present.
* Vox Engines can be heard spewing Cyborg propaganda, allowing Helldivers early warning of their approach.
* Vox Engines have three sets of two weapons each: 
** Plasma Macro-Culverins mounted on each side of its torso.
** Plasma Duster Miniguns mounted on each side of its undercarriage.
** and Icarus Missile Launcher Pods mounted on the back of its Torso, right behind its Macro-Culverins.
* When alerted, Vox Engines will blare an alarm from the loudspeakers atop the units as they begin to approach Helldivers, engaging with their various weaponry depending on distance.

War Strider.title: War Strider
War Strider.spawning:
Appearing at {{Difficulty|6}} and above, the War Strider can spawn in [[Automaton Outpost]]s, from [[Bulk Fabricator]]s, or within [[Dropship|Bot Drops]]. They also spawn in patrols outside of the [[Metropolis]] biome.

Certain mission types are devoid of War Striders unless they take place in an urban environment such as a [[Metropolis]]. These missions include [[Emergency Evacuation]], [[Retrieve Valuable Data]], [[Conduct Geological Survey]], and [[Spread Democracy]].<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/Helldivers/comments/1nhp8k9/psa_war_strider_does_not_spawn_in_these_missions/</ref>

During a mission, War Striders replace [[Tank (disambiguation)#Helldivers 2|Automaton Tanks]] slots.
War Strider.behavior:
Upon spotting [[Helldiver]]s, the War Strider will fire volleys of grenades and lasers if at range, or will stomp if a Helldiver gets too close. Their Culverins are fired in bursts of 8 before cooling down for about 4 seconds.

War Striders are slow and will not often pursue Helldivers, instead launching a salvo of 10 grenades at them with their Grenade Projectors if at a sufficient distance and generally firing their Fusion Culverins. Such grenades are fired on a steep arc, allowing them to potentially ignore cover.

Warrior.title: Warrior
Warrior.spawning:
{{PAGENAME}}s can be found on all difficulties, spawning from [[Bug Breach|Bug Breaches]], within patrols, guarding [[Bug Nest]]s and [[Objectives]], or from [[Bug Hole|Bug Holes]]. They can also be spawned in a trio by [[Brood Commander]]s.

Starting on {{Difficulty|4}}, they can be found guarding [[Minor Places of Interest]].
Warrior.behavior:
Warriors will simply approach [[The Helldivers|Helldivers]], climbing over terrain and obstacles in an attempt to attack with their claws at close range. They can strafe sideways, and will attempt to cut off Helldivers trying to run past them. When their head is destroyed, Warriors will enter a "berserk" state, where they gain increased movement speed but continuously bleed out.

Rarely, and when a Helldiver is out of its reach, it will dig underground, then suddenly emerge and attack the Helldiver.

Warriors are able to release a cloud of pheromones into the air that causes a Bug Breach.

Watcher.title: Watcher
Watcher.spawning: Watchers can be found on all difficulties, spawning throughout the map. They do not spawn on planets occupied by [[Vote Snatchers]].
Watcher.behavior:
Watchers fly around the map and scan its surroundings with a luminescent blue light, visualizing its point of view. Once alerted, through direct line of sight of a [[Helldiver]], attacks directly at them, or near them, it will shine a bright pink light and begin investigating.

Upon spotting Helldivers once more, or while being continuously attacked by them, Watchers will typically halt and emit holographic flares that call in [[Warp Ship|Warp Ships]] for reinforcements. 

They may also attack with its Tesla Suppressor, firing debilitating [[Damage#Damage Types|arcs]] of lightning when [[Helldivers]] are close to it.

Wretch.title: Wretch
Wretch.spawning:
* Since there are no [[Watcher|Watchers]] to call reinforcements on a planet occupied by [[Vote Snatchers]], Wretches will only spawn naturally as patrols and guarding points of interest.
** However, they spawn in much greater numbers comparatively.
* They, along with [[Crusher|Crushers]], are spawned from [[Warp Ship|Warp Ships]] during [[Repel Invasion Fleet]] missions on planets where the Vote Snatchers are active.
Wretch.behavior: When a Wretch spots a Helldiver they will generally approach in a straight line, but will sometimes dart around cover to try and flank the Helldiver. It is not uncommon to be firing at a pair of Wretches only for another to attack from behind. They can move surprisingly fast and once in range they will pounce at Helldivers, dealing significant damage. This pounce attack also strongly tracks a moving Helldiver which makes it difficult to dodge.
